description: Qualifying investment thresholds for Turkish citizenship under Law No. 5901 Art. 12(1)(b) and Art. 20 of the implementing Regulation.

current.label: Real estate
current.basis: Official SPK-licensed appraisal value, not the contract price
current.annotation: Three-year no-sale annotation recorded on the title deed (tapu)

current.label: Bank deposit
current.basis: Turkish lira deposit in a bank operating in Turkiye, after the foreign currency is sold to the bank and by the bank to the Central Bank (Regulation Art. 20(10), since 6 January 2022)

current.label: Government bonds
current.basis: Certified by the Ministry of Treasury and Finance
current.conversionNote: Whether the Art. 20(10) lira-conversion requirement applies to this sub-paragraph is not yet confirmed by counsel.

current.label: Investment fund shares
current.basis: Real-estate or venture capital fund shares (GYF/GSYF)
current.conversionNote: Whether the Art. 20(10) lira-conversion requirement applies to this sub-paragraph is not yet confirmed by counsel.

current.label: Fixed capital investment
current.basis: Certified by the Ministry of Industry and Technology
current.conversionNote: Whether the Art. 20(10) lira-conversion requirement applies to this sub-paragraph is not yet confirmed by counsel.

current.label: Private pension contribution
current.basis: Contribution to a private pension (BES) held in funds determined by the Insurance and Private Pension Regulation and Supervision Agency (SEDDK), which also certifies that the contribution was made
current.holdingNote: Three years in the private pension system, running from the date the lira equivalent reaches the company's accounts rather than from the contract date.
current.conversionNote: Lira conversion applies on this route: the Central Bank issued an application instruction for the foreign-currency sale. The exact mechanism is not restated here from the instruction's own text, which we have not read.
notes: A later fall in the accumulated balance below USD 500,000 caused by exchange-rate movement does not of itself affect the application.
The contribution may not be split across more than one pension contract.

The 30 per cent state contribution to private pensions does not apply, because Additional Article 1 of Law No. 4632 requires the participant to be a Turkish citizen and the foreign investor is not one at the time of the contribution.

current.label: Job creation
current.basis: Certified by the Ministry of Labour and Social Security

familyInclusion.note: Age is assessed at the application date, not at the decision date.

requirements.currencyConversionCertificate: Mandatory (doviz alim belgesi); funds must move through the Turkish banking system

sources.note: Official corroboration of all seven routes and of the ministry or agency that certifies each. Not the legal basis for any figure.
